arxiv-2001-10975.title: A Hybrid Density Functional Theory Benchmark Study on Lithium Manganese Oxides
arxiv-2001-10975.creator: Marco Eckhoff, Peter E. Blöchl, Jörg Behler
arxiv-2001-10975.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Marco Eckhoff, Peter E. Blöchl, Jörg Behler. The lithium manganese oxide spinel Li x Mn 2 O 4 , with 0 ≤ x ≤ 2 0\leq x\leq 2 , is an important example for cathode materials in lithium ion batteries. However, an accurate description of Li x Mn 2 O 4 by first-principles methods like density functional theory is far from trivial due to its complex electronic structure, with a variety of energetically close electronic and magnetic states.

arxiv-2109-11353.title: Cauchy problem for a fractional anisotropic parabolic equation in
arxiv-2109-11353.creator: anisotropic Hölder spaces.
arxiv-2109-11353.description: Abstract We consider a Cauchy problem for a fractional anisotropic parabolic equation in anisotropic Hölder spaces. The equation generalizes the heat equation to the case of fractional power of the Laplace operator and the power of this operator can be different with respect to different groups of space variables.

arxiv-2206-00359.title: DeepCluE: Enhanced Deep Clustering via Multi-layer Ensembles in Neural Networks Thanks: D. Huang, D.-H. Chen, and X. Chen are with the College of Mathematics and Informatics, South China Agricultural University, Guangzhou, China. E-mail: huangdonghere@gmail.com, dinghuachen@hotmail.com, xiangjichen@
arxiv-2206-00359.creator: Dong Huang, Ding-Hua Chen, Xiangji Chen, Chang-Dong Wang
arxiv-2206-00359.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dong Huang, Ding-Hua Chen, Xiangji Chen, Chang-Dong Wang. Deep clustering has recently emerged as a promising technique for complex data clustering. Despite the considerable progress, previous deep clustering works mostly build or learn the final clustering by only utilizing a single layer of representation, e.g., by performing the K K -means clustering on the last fully-connected layer or by associating some clustering loss to a specific layer, which neglect the possibilities of jointly leveraging multi-layer representations for enhancing the deep clustering performance.

arxiv-2307-11555.description: Abstract Recently, interest has grown in exploring the hypothesis that neural activity conveys information through precise spiking motifs. To investigate this phenomenon, various algorithms have been proposed to detect such motifs in Single Unit Activity (SUA) recorded from populations of neurons.

arxiv-2308-14313.title: Three-dimensional flat Landau levels in an inhomogeneous acoustic crystal
arxiv-2308-14313.creator: Zheyu Cheng, Yi-jun Guan, Haoran Xue, Yong Ge, Ding Jia, Yang Long, Shou-qi Yuan, Hong-xiang Sun, Yidong Chong, Baile Zhang
arxiv-2308-14313.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zheyu Cheng, Yi-jun Guan, Haoran Xue, Yong Ge, Ding Jia, Yang Long, Shou-qi Yuan, Hong-xiang Sun, Yidong Chong, Baile Zhang. When electrons moving in two-dimensions (2D) are subjected to a strong uniform magnetic field, they form flat bands called Landau levels, which are the basis for the quantum Hall effect.

arxiv-2403-00895.description: Abstract . Recent recommender system advancements have focused on developing sequence-based and graph-based approaches. Both approaches proved useful in modeling intricate relationships within behavioral data, leading to promising outcomes in personalized ranking and next-item recommendation tasks while maintaining good scalability. However, they capture very different signals from data.

arxiv-2501-06304.title: Continuum Reverberation in Active Galactic Nuclei Disks Only With Sufficient X-ray Luminosity and Low Albedo
arxiv-2501-06304.creator: Amy Secunda, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞), Jenny E. Greene
arxiv-2501-06304.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Amy Secunda, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞), Jenny E. Greene. Disk continuum reverberation mapping is one of the primary ways we learn about active galactic nuclei (AGN) accretion disks. Reverberation mapping assumes that time-varying X-rays incident on the accretion disk drive variability in UV-optical light curves emitted by AGN disks, and uses lags between X-ray and UV-optical variability on the light-crossing timescale to measure the radial temperature profile and extent of AGN disks.

arxiv-2502-10951.title: Prompt and Conventional High-Energy Muon Spectra from a full Monte Carlo Simulation via CORSIKA7
arxiv-2502-10951.creator: Ludwig Neste, Pascal Gutjahr, Mirco Hünnefeld, Jean-Marco Alameddine, Wolfgang Rhode, Julia Becker Tjus, Felix Riehn, Kevin Kröninger, Johannes Albrecht
arxiv-2502-10951.description: Abstract Extensive air showers produce high-energy muons that can be utilized to probe hadronic interaction models in cosmic ray interactions. Most muons originate from pion and kaon decays, called conventional muons, while a smaller fraction, referred to as prompt muons, arises from the decay of heavier, short-lived hadrons.

arxiv-2511-17411.title: SPEAR-1: Scaling Beyond Robot Demonstrations via 3D Understanding
arxiv-2511-17411.creator: Nikolay Nikolov Giuliano Albanese Sombit Dey Aleksandar Yanev Luc Van Gool Jan-Nico Zaech Danda Pani Paudel {nikolay.nikolov, giuliano.albanese, sombit.dey, aleksandar.yanev luc.vangool, jan-nico.zaech, danda.paudel}@insait.ai INSAIT, Sofia University ”St. Kliment Ohridski”
arxiv-2511-17411.description: Abstract Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs) hold great promise as generalist, end-to-end systems for robot control. Yet their ability to generalize across new environments, tasks, and embodiments remains limited. We argue that a major bottleneck lies in their foundations: most RFMs are built by fine-tuning internet-pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

arxiv-2512-06524.title: TacFinRay: Soft Tactile Fin-Ray Finger with Indirect Tactile Sensing for Robust Grasping
arxiv-2512-06524.creator: Saekwang Nam, Bowen Deng, Loong Yi Lee, Jonathan M. Rossiter, Nathan F. Lepora
arxiv-2512-06524.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Saekwang Nam, Bowen Deng, Loong Yi Lee, Jonathan M. Rossiter, Nathan F. Lepora. We present a tactile-sensorized Fin-Ray finger that enables simultaneous detection of contact location and indentation depth through an indirect sensing approach. A hinge mechanism is integrated between the soft Fin-Ray structure and a rigid sensing module, allowing deformation and translation information to be transferred to a bottom crossbeam upon which are an array of marker-tipped pins based on the biomimetic structure of the TacTip vision-based tactile sensor.

pmc-10596690.title: Ultra-processed food consumption, nutrition quality, and obesity prevalence in Israel
pmc-10596690.creator: L Keinan Boker, T Shimony, D R Shahar
pmc-10596690.description: Obesity is associated with chronic disease and burdens individuals and health systems heavily. Obesity prevalence has increased globally in recent decades. Concurrently, consumption of natural and home-prepared foods has decreased while that of industrial and ultra-processed foods (UPFs) that may play a role in obesity etiology, has increased.

pmc-11304575.title: Learning curve of ultrasound-guided percutaneous central venous port placement in children
pmc-11304575.creator: Ho Jong Jeon, Kyong Ihn, In Geol Ho
pmc-11304575.description: BackgroundAlthough percutaneous central venous port (CVP) placement can be quickly performed using minimally invasive surgery, short- and long-term complications can occur. Beginner pediatric surgeons must overcome learning curves influencing operative time and complication rates. However, few studies have been conducted on the learning curve of ultrasound-guided percutaneous CVP placement.

pmc-11390484.title: Spectroscopic confirmation of two luminous galaxies at a redshift of 14
pmc-11390484.creator: Stefano Carniani, Kevin Hainline, Francesco D’Eugenio, Daniel J Eisenstein, Peter Jakobsen, Joris Witstok, Benjamin D Johnson, Jacopo Chevallard, Roberto Maiolino, Jakob M Helton, Chris Willott, Brant Robertson, Stacey Alberts, Santiago Arribas, William M Baker, Rachana Bhatawdekar, Kristan Boyett,
pmc-11390484.description: The first observations of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have revolutionized our understanding of the Universe by identifying galaxies at redshift z ≈ 13 (refs. 1–3). In addition, the discovery of many luminous galaxies at Cosmic Dawn (z > 10) has suggested that galaxies developed rapidly, in apparent tension with many standard models4–8.

pmc-11435000.title: Capsaicin Improves Systemic Inflammation, Atherosclerosis, and Macrophage-Derived Foam Cells by Stimulating PPAR Gamma and TRPV1 Receptors
pmc-11435000.creator: Danielle Lima Ávila, Weslley Fernandes-Braga, Janayne Luihan Silva, Elandia Aparecida Santos, Gianne Campos, Paola Caroline Lacerda Leocádio, Luciano Santos Aggum Capettini, Edenil Costa Aguilar, Jacqueline Isaura Alvarez-Leite
pmc-11435000.description: Background: Capsaicin, a bioactive compound found in peppers, is recognized for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-lipidemic properties. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of capsaicin on atherosclerosis progression. Methods: Apolipoprotein E knockout mice and their C57BL/6 controls were utilized to assess blood lipid profile, inflammatory status, and atherosclerotic lesions.

pmc-11451158.title: Predictors of change in CD4 cell count over time for HIV/AIDS patients on ART follow-up in northern Ethiopia: a retrospective longitudinal study
pmc-11451158.creator: Gebru Gebremeskel Gebrerufael, Zeytu Gashaw Asfaw
pmc-11451158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundHIV has an effect on lowering CD4 cell count, which lowers the ability to resist contamination. For patients on ART in areas with limited resources, the CD4 cell count assessment is crucial for determining treatment responses and therapeutic decisions. The volatility of CD4 counts following the introduction of ART over time is still largely uncharacterized, and there are few fresh datasets on CD4 cell count progressions.

pmc-11454953.title: Estimating the prevalence of select non-communicable diseases in Saudi Arabia using a population-based sample: econometric analysis with natural language processing
pmc-11454953.creator: Suliman Alghnam, Mohammad Bosaeed, Abdulrahman Aljouie, Saeed Mastour Alshahrani, Omar Alshenqeety, Rifat Atun, Saleh Alqahtani
pmc-11454953.description: BACKGROUND: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) are a major public health challenge globally, including in Saudi Arabia. However, measuring the true extent of NCD prevalence has been hampered by a paucity of nationally representative epidemiological studies.OBJECTIVES: Assess the prevalence of selected NCDs, using population-based electronic health records and applying novel analytical methods to identify cases of NCDs.

pmc-12610299.title: The Real-World Impact of PARP Inhibitor Maintenance Therapy in High Grade Serous Tubo-Ovarian and Peritoneal Cancers
pmc-12610299.creator: Maryam Al-Ani, Bahaaeldin Baraka, Navin Mathiyalagan, Muhammad Adeel Sarwar, Avinash Segaran, Wafaa Abuzahra, Alayna Radford, Kersty Buxton, Lalith Seneviratne, Santhanam Sundar, Anjana Anand, David Nunns, Karin Williamson, Ben Wormald, Ketankumar Gajjar, Srinivasan Madhusudan, Dimitrios Tsolakidis
pmc-12610299.description: Simple SummaryPARP inhibitor (olaparib, niraparib, or rucaparib) maintenance treatment is a standard treatment option in patients with high-grade serous tubo-ovarian and peritoneal cancers following surgery and chemotherapy. Whether olaparib, niraparib, or rucaparib have similar clinical benefit is an area of clinical investigation.

pmc-12667190.title: Characterization of cell-type specific knockout of different elements of the endocannabinoid system in cortical glutamatergic neurons in the context of stress-induced behavioral phenotype
pmc-12667190.creator: Margarita Tevosian, Alex F Brown, Christina Schneider, Andrea Conrad, Ermelinda Lomazzo, Beat Lutz
pmc-12667190.description: BackgroundChronic stress is an important factor for the development of mental health impairments, such as depression and generalized anxiety disorder. Chronic social defeat (CSD) stress is an ethologically valid model of chronic stress in rodents, combining elements of psychological and physical stress.

pmc-13174042.title: AI model predicts patient outcomes from surgical gestures and provides insights into explainability
pmc-13174042.creator: John R. Heard, Atharva Deo, Umar Ghaffar, Runzhuo Ma, Cherine Yang, Ujjwal Pasupulety, Jasmine Lin, Carter M. Prentice, Hyung L. Kim, Melissa Assel, Christian Wagner, Geoffrey A. Sonn, Alvin C. Goh, Andrew Vickers, Jim C. Hu, Andrew J. Hung
pmc-13174042.description: Effective surgical training requires relatively immediate feedback as to outcomes. This makes surgical learning problematic as some surgical outcomes may take months or years to become apparent. The sequence of surgical gestures, the smallest discrete actions of surgery, during the nerve-sparing step of robot-assisted radical prostatectomy has been used to predict 1-year erectile function (EF) outcomes after surgery.

pmc-13221162.title: A decade of global orthopaedic research in SICOT-J (2015–2025): a scientometric analysis of publication trends, collaboration, and citation impact
pmc-13221162.creator: Raju Vaishya, Brij Mohan Gupta, Mallikarjun Kappi, Abhishek Vaish, Andreas F Mavrogenis, Sébastien Lustig, Vikas Khanduja
pmc-13221162.description: Background: The SICOT-J, an open-access orthopedic journal affiliated with the Société Internationale de Chirurgie Orthopédique et de Traumatologie (SICOT), has been a global orthopedic research platform since 2015. This study provides a scientometric analysis of SICOT-J publications from 2015 to 2025 to evaluate research productivity, citation impact, and collaboration patterns.

pmc-13294874.title: Impact of Surface Coatings on the Photocatalytic Activity and Cytotoxicity of Titanium Dioxide Nanoparticles in Human Keratinocytes: Implications for Sunscreen Safety
pmc-13294874.creator: Maria Eleni Katsanou, Philipp-Kjell Ficht, Lienhard Wegewitz, Jörg Adams, Lars Böckmann, Steffen Emmert, Wolfgang Maus-Friedrichs
pmc-13294874.description: Titanium dioxide nanoparticles (TiO2 NPs) are widely used in sunscreens as UV filters because of their high UV absorption efficiency. However, their potential to generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) under UV irradiation raises concerns about their photocatalytic activity and associated cytotoxicity.

pmc-13316682.title: Assessing Polypoidal Choroidal Vasculopathy-Related OCT Features in the TENAYA and LUCERNE Trials
pmc-13316682.creator: Kelvin Yi Chong Teo, Philippe Margaron, Timothy YY Lai, Won Ki Lee, Srinivas R Sadda, Giovanni Staurenghi, Shriji Patel, Chui Ming Gemmy Cheung
pmc-13316682.description: ObjectiveTo describe OCT features associated with polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy (PCV) in the TENAYA and LUCERNE clinical trial cohorts.DesignImaging analysis within 2 multinational, double-masked, randomized controlled phase III trials.SubjectsParticipants with treatment-naïve neovascular age-related macular degeneration enrolled in TENAYA and LUCERNE with baseline OCT and in a subset, baseline indocyanine green angiography (ICGA).

pmc-13617286.title: Immune-related biomarkers in liquid biopsy for cancer: emerging tools for non-invasive precision oncology
pmc-13617286.creator: Lai Wen, Xinhui Wang, Jinming Liu, Xinxin Pan, Yixin Zhang, Shuang Li, Mengying Tong, Yuankuan Jiang, Hewen Guan
pmc-13617286.description: Liquid biopsy has emerged as a powerful non-invasive tool in precision oncology, providing real-time insights into tumor evolution, host immune responses, and dynamic changes in the tumor immune microenvironment. By enabling minimally invasive sampling, it can overcome several limitations of conventional tissue biopsy.

pmc-13618728.title: Diagnostic yield of medical thoracoscopy: five-year experience at a tertiary care center
pmc-13618728.creator: Pedro Fernandes, Tito Abrantes, Carla António, Joana Correia, Ana Luís Correia, Beatriz Dias, António Reis, Teresa Belo
pmc-13618728.description: dy was to evaluate the diagnostic yield and safety of MT in patients with undiagnosed pleural effusion after initial workup. We conducted a retrospective study including all of the patients who, after noninvasive evaluation, underwent MT for pleural effusion of unknown cause at Centro Hospitalar Tondela-Viseu, in the city of Viseu, Portugal, between July of 2020 and July of 2025.

pmc-13670133.title: Telepharmacological Consultation for Polypharmacy Management in Primary Care: A Qualitative Study of General Practitioners' Experiences With Cross‐Sectoral Coordination
pmc-13670133.creator: Daniel Pilsgaard Henriksen
pmc-13670133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The telepharmacological outpatient clinic (TPOC) is a hospital service in which clinical pharmacologists and clinical pharmacists review a patient's full medication regimen and hospital record, then discuss it with the referring general practitioner (GP) by video conference. Seven GPs in the Region of Southern Denmark who had used or been introduced to the service were interviewed to explore how it was used and what prevented wider use. Interviews were semi‐structured and analysed thematically.
